name: Bram Van Pevenage
title: Software Engineer, on the path to IT Architect
summary: Builder by heart, computer scientist by trade. I'm a .NET-focused software engineer working toward IT architecture, with a growing specialization in microservices, security-by-design, and compliance (NIS2, DORA). Alongside my day-to-day work I run a small freelance practice building web and IoT systems for clients, and I stay involved in my community as a football coach and as financial administrator of a local youth club.
